senses.gloss:
शच् शच्, cl. 1. A. शचते, शेचे, शचितुम्,
to speak, say, tell; to be strong, &c., (in
this sense for rt. 1. शक्, see the derivatives below.)
षाच् षाच् for साच्, q. v.

सच् सच् (closely connected and by some
identified with rt. सश्च्, q. v., cf. rt. सप्),
cl. 1. A., 3. P. सचते (sometimes also P. सचति),
सिषक्ति (Ved., Pot. 1st pl. सक्षीमहि = सङ्गच्-
[]
छेमहि, Impv. 2nd sing. सक्ष्वा for सक्ष्व),
सक्तुम् (Ved. Inf. सचध्यै), Ved. to follow,
pursue, seek after, attend on, become attached to
(sometimes with inst.); to love, like; to celebrate,
honour, worship, serve, obey, be obedient to (with acc.
or gen.); to favour, assist, aid; to be associated with,
(त्वं सचसे पुरन्ध्या, thou art associated with
devotion, Ṛg-veda II. 1, 3); to go towards, go to,
(in Naigh. II. 14. सचति and सक्षति are enume-
rated among the गति-कर्माणः); to attain, obtain,
acquire, gain, accomplish; [cf. Gr. ἕπ-ω, ἕ-σπ-ο-ν,
ἕπ-ο-μαι, ἑ-σπ-ό-μην, ἑπ-έ-της, ὅπ-λο-ν, ὁπλότερος,
ἑκάς: Lat. sequ-o-r, sec-u-ndu-s, ad-sec-la,
sec-to-r, pedis-sequa, soc-iu-s, sec-us, sacer: Lith.
sek-u, ‘I follow:’ Hib. seichim, ‘I follow, pursue;’
seicin, ‘pursuit.’]

साच् साच् (fr. rt. सच्), Ved. in अपत्य-साच्,
नृ-षाच्.
शचि, इस्, f. = शची below.

शची, f. speech, power of speech, eloquence (= वाच्,
Naigh. I. 11); activity, diligence, energy, skilfulness
(= प्रज्ञा, Naigh. III. 9); power, strength, action,
exploit, (Sāy. and Naigh. II. 1 = कर्म); any holy
act, devotion; N. of the wife of Indra, (in the pre-
ceding senses chiefly Ved.); the plant Asparagus
Racemosus; the astronomical Karaṇa or period
named Viṣṭi; Śacī Paulomī is given as the authoress
of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 159.
—शची-नर, अस्,
m., N. of a king of Kaśmīra.
—शची-पति, इस्, m.
‘lord of power,’ or ‘husband of Śacī,’ epithet of
Indra; (ई), m. du. ‘lords of pious acts,’ epithet of
the Aśvins (Ved.)
—शची-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved.
possessing power, strong, (Sāy. = कर्म-वत्); wise,
(Sāy. = प्रज्ञा-वत्); (आन्), m. epithet of Indra,
(शचीवस्, voc. c. ‘O powerful one.’)
—शची-वसु,
उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. rich or abounding in strength, en-
riched by holy rites.

शाचि शाचि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. शच्, cf. शचि),
distinguished, renowned; strong.
—शाचि-गु, उस्, उस्,
उ, Ved. having strong or renowned cattle; having
powerful or clearly manifested rays.
—शाचि-पूजन,
अम्, n., Ved. vehement or earnest worship; (अस्, आ,
अम्), Ved. having strong or earnest worship.

सचि, इस्, m. an associate, friend [cf. सखि]; con-
nection, intimacy, friendship; (इस्), f. the wife of
Indra, (also written शचि.)
—सचि-विद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved.
knowing or appreciating friendship.

सची, f. the wife of Indra, (also written शची,
q. v.)
—सची-नन्दन, अस्, m. ‘Sacī's delight,’ epi-
thet of Jayanta (son of Sacī and Indra).

साचि साचि, ind. (probably loc. c. of a word
formed fr. स + rt. 1. अञ्च्, see 2. अञ्च्), crookedly,
awry, in a sidelong manner, obliquely, bent on one
side.
—साचि-वाटिका, f. the white-flowered hogweed.
—साचि-विलोकित, अम्, n. a side-long glance.
—साचि-
स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, standing or placed unevenly;
standing across.
—साची-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c.,
to make crooked, bend or turn aside.
—साची-कृत,
अस्, आ, अम्, made crooked; bent, inclined, seen
crookedly or tortuously, distorted, misrepresented;
(अम्), n. distortion or perversion of mind, prejudice.
—साची-गुण, N. of a place or district.

शचिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. strongest, most power-
ful, very powerful.

सचथ, Ved. companionship, assistance, (Sāy.
सचथाय = सचनाय, i. e. याग-सहाय-कर-
णाय, for giving assistance at the sacrifice.)

सचथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = सचनीय, to be fol-
lowed or served, to be honoured, worthy of honour,
(Sāy. = सेवार्ह; in Ṛg-veda V. 50, 2. सचथ्य
is made a substantive and interpreted by काम, i. e.
any desirable thing.)

सचन, अम्, आ, n. f., Ved. the act of honouring,
favouring, assisting; honour, service; (अस्, आ, अम्),
to be honoured or served (= सेव्य).
—सचनस्-
तम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be excessively followed or
honoured.
—सचना-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing
honour, honoured.

सचान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. following, pursuing, &c.;
being associated with.

सचनस्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. desiring attach-
ment or union, (Sāy. = सम्पर्कम् इच्छत्, Ṛg-
veda X. 4, 3.)

सचनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be followed, to be
honoured or served.

सचमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. following, pursuing,
seeking after, &c.

सचा (thought by some to be fr. साञ्च्, i. e. स +
अञ्च्, ‘going with,’ cf. साचि; but more probably an
inst. of a form सच्), ind., Ved. along with, at the same
time with, together with, with (= 2. सह, but some-
times used with loc. and even with gen. and dat.; Sāy.
often interprets this word by सहाय, ‘an associate,
helper,’ evidently connecting it with rt. सच्); with
the assistance of.
—सचा-भू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, Ved. being
along with, united with, associated with, an associate,
(Sāy. = सह वर्तमान.)

सचिव, अस्, m. an associate, companion, friend;
a counsellor, minister; the dark thorn-apple; (आ),
f., see Vopa-deva VI. 13.
—सचिव-ता, f. the position
or rank of a minister.
—सचिवामय (˚व-आम्˚),
अस्, m. the disease Vi-sarpa.

सचकित स-चकित, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling,
timorous, timid, startled; (अम्), ind. tremblingly, with
alarm, timidly, timorously, in a startled manner.

सचक्र स-चक्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having a circle
or discus; (अम्), ind. together with a wheel or
discus.

सचक्षुस् स-चक्षुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्, having eyes,
seeing.
स-चक्षुष, अस्, आ, अम्, having eyes, seeing.

सचनस् स-चनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. having
the same food, (Sāy. = समानान्न, Ṛg-veda I.
127, 11); (according to some) being in company
with, accompanied by; [cf. सचन.]

सचरणलाक्षाराग स-चरण-लाक्षा-राग,
अस्, आ, अम्, having the colour of feet-lac, i. e. lac used
for (dyeing) the feet.

सचराचर स-चराचर (˚र-अच्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
comprehending all moving and motionless creatures,
comprising animate and inanimate, having all things,
universal; (अम्), n. the universe.

सचल स-चल, अस्, आ, अम्, having moving
things; moving.
सचारु स-चारु, उस्, -र्वी, उ, very beautiful.

सचित्र स-चित्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having pictures,
painted, variegated.

सचिल्लक स-चिल्लक, अस्, आ, अम्, having sore
eyes, blear-eyed.

सचेतन स-चेतन, अस्, आ, अम्, having con-
sciousness, conscious, sentient, sensible, animate,
rational; having feeling; recovering sense or con-
sciousness.

स-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, conscious, reflective, intelli-
gent; having the same mind, unanimous.

सचेल स-चेल, अस्, आ, अम्, having clothes,
clothed, dressed.

सचेष्ट स-चेष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, making effort
or exertion, active; (अस्), m. the mango tree, Man-
gifera Indica.
सच्चरित सच्-चरित. See under सत्.
सच्चारा सच्चारा, f. turmeric.

सच्चिदंश सच्-चिद्-अंश, सच्-चिद्-आनन्द, &c.
See under सत्, p. 1052.

सच्छिद्र स-च्छिद्र (स-छ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having defects, faulty.
सच्छूद्र सच्-छूद्र. See under सत्.

सच्छेद स-च्छेद (स-छ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having
cuttings or divisions, having interruptions, interrupted.

साचिन् in सव्य-स्˚, q. v. (perhaps connected with
साचि below).

साचिव्य साचिव्य, अम्, n. (fr. सचिव), com-
panionship, friendship, fellowship; the office of a
counsellor, ministership, ministry, administration.

साचीवित् साचीवित्, ind. (in Naigh. II. 15.
enumerated among the क्षिप्र-नामानि).
